# TOMER ZOREF

> Portfolio of Tomer Zoref (תומר צורף), a 19-year-old photographer and video creator in Israel with four years of experience. He shoots events, parties, brand campaigns and sports. The site is in Hebrew.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tomerzoref.com/): photo gallery (sports, parties, events, portraits, street), videos (reels, brand films, event recaps), about and contact
- [Accessibility statement](https://tomerzoref.com/accessibility.html): accessibility features, known limitations and how to report an accessibility issue

## Services

- Event photography (צילום אירועים)
- Party photography (צילום מסיבות)
- Campaign photography (צילום קמפיינים)
- Sports photography (צילום ספורט)
- Video: reels, brand films and event recaps
